points.text: Is the Arabic text easy to read at phone size?
Does the layout read right to left, with the start of each row on the right?
Do the arrows and chevrons point the right way for Arabic?
Do the numbers read correctly, with digits and symbols in the right order?
Does each of the eight rows show a date, a merchant, an amount and whether money came in or went out?
Do English merchant names like Lulu Hypermarket and Netflix sit cleanly in the Arabic row?
Do the OMR amounts show three decimals and stay readable?
Can you tell money in from money out at a glance?
Are the balance and the this-month filter easy to find above the table?
Do all eight rows line up in their columns?
